title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Temporary Accounts / Admin Assistant

Location: Fully onsite - Scotstoun
Hours: Circa 25 hours per week - flexible around working hours
Contract: Temporary, initially for a couple of months
Start: ASAP

Are you an experienced Accounts Administrator or Accounts Assistant looking for a temporary opportunity within a friendly, close-knit business?

We're currently recruiting for a Temporary Accounts / Admin Assistant to provide additional support to a small, family-run business during a period of change.

The business is preparing to introduce new systems, with implementation planned for 1 December, so this is a great opportunity for someone who can come in, get up to speed quickly and help keep the day-to-day accounts and office administration running smoothly during the transition.

The Role

Working as part of a small team, you'll provide hands-on support across accounts, administration and general office duties, including:
- Processing purchase invoices and supporting the purchase ledger
- Raising customer invoices and assisting with the sales ledger
- Dealing with supplier and customer queries via phone and email
- Keeping Sage 50 records accurate and up to date
- Supporting with credit control where required
- Filing, scanning and maintaining accurate records
- Data entry and updating internal systems
- General office administration and organisation
- Answering and directing telephone calls
- Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence
- Assisting with general office tasks and keeping the office organised
- Supporting the wider team with ad hoc administrative duties
- Helping to keep day-to-day processes organised during the transition to new systems

About You

We're looking for someone who is practical, reliable and organised, with the confidence to work independently in a small business environment.

You'll need:
- Previous hands-on accounts and administration experience
- Strong experience using Sage 50 - this is essential
- Good attention to detail and accurate data entry skills
- Confidence dealing with customers and suppliers
- Good telephone and communication skills
- The ability to manage your own workload and work with minimal supervision
- A flexible, hands-on approach and willingness to get involved wherever needed

Experience using Xero would be advantageous but is not essential.

Credit control experience would also be beneficial, although this is not a requirement.

What's on offer?
- Temporary assignment initially for around 3 months
- Circa 25 hours per week
- Flexible working hours to suit the successful candidate
- Fully onsite within a small, friendly team
- Immediate opportunity to provide valuable support during a period of systems change
- Potential for the assignment to extend depending on business requirements

If you're an experienced Accounts/Admin professional with strong Sage 50 experience and you're looking for a flexible temporary opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Gemma at Iconic Resourcing for more information.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Start date: 30.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Glasgow Competitive Salary + Benefits Full-Time Permanent

A well-established and growing accountancy practice based in the South Side of Glasgow, are seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join its team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a payroll professional looking to develop their career within a supportive practice environment, working with a varied portfolio of clients across multiple sectors.

The Role

As Payroll Administrator, you will play a key role in delivering accurate and timely payroll services to a diverse client base. You will be responsible for managing payroll processes whilst ensuring compliance with relevant legislation and maintaining excellent client relationships.

Duties will include:
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls
- Calculating salaries, overtime, bonuses, commissions and statutory payments
- Managing pension contributions and auto-enrolment requirements
- Submitting RTI information to HMRC
- Processing new starters, leavers and payroll amendments
- Handling SSP, SMP, SPP and other statutory payments
- Producing payroll reports and reconciliations
- Responding to client payroll queries in a professional and timely manner
- Ensuring payroll records are accurate and maintained in line with current legislation

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous payroll experience, ideally within an accountancy practice or bureau environment
- Strong knowledge of payroll legislation and HMRC requirements
- Experience using payroll software packages
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good communication and client-facing abilities
- A proactive and professional approach to work
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively

Payroll qualifications are advantageous but not essential for candidates with relevant experience.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Flexible and supportive working environment
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Opportunity to work with a wide range of clients
- Friendly and collaborative team culture
- Long-term career progression opportunities

Apply

If you are an experienced Payroll Administrator looking for your next opportunity with a respected accountancy practice in the Glasgow area, please apply with an up to date copy of your CV or get in touch with Zoe King at Reed for more information.
